svg.title: Gibbs overshoot under rescaling
svg.desc: Odd Fourier sums M=4,12,48 near the jump and under y=2Mt. The transition shrinks in time but the overshoot approaches 1.1789797445. The grey sine-integral limit uses numerical quadrature.
